description: Humanoid alien species that initially fight alongside the Arachnids but switch sides to ally with the Terran Mobile Infantry in later scenarios. Represented by yellow/gold counters.

unit_types.name: Humanoid Warrior
unit_types.description: Standard humanoid combat unit. Yellow/gold counters with black numbering.
abilities: Can ally with Terrans in later scenarios

unit_types.name: Humanoid Worker
unit_types.description: Non-combat humanoid unit. No offensive capability.

unit_types.name: Humanoid Heavy Weapon - Beam
unit_types.description: Humanoid heavy energy weapon. Red numbering on counter to indicate ranged capability.

unit_types.name: Humanoid Heavy Weapon - Missile
unit_types.description: Humanoid heavy missile weapon. Red numbering on counter to indicate ranged capability.

special_rules.alliance_switch: In later scenarios (Revolt! and beyond), Humanoid units switch from the Arachnid side to the Terran side.
special_rules.stacking: Terran and Humanoid units may not voluntarily stack together or remain in the same hex unless involuntarily immobilized as a result of combat.
special_rules.combined_attacks: Terran and Humanoid units may not combine attack strengths for any type of ranged or close combat. They may not attack the same enemy unit in the same combat phase.
special_rules.combat_tables: Humanoid units use the Terran attack table when attacking Arachnid units and vice versa.
